name: Region-Based Progressive Rendering
definition: A progressive transmission and rendering scheme for volume data that prioritizes specific regions of interest (ROI) over the entire volume, providing clearer rendering results for the ROI compared to coarse-to-fine methods.
summary: Region-Based Progressive Rendering prioritizes a user-defined ROI at high resolution first, avoiding low-resolution interference to provide a clearer initial view than coarse-to-fine schemes.
